text:
maria: Heads-up — legal needs per-region EULA localization + a support matrix before we publish AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace offers. Need quick decisions: which locales, who owns support routing (partner vs Redwood), and SLA mapping per SKU.

raj: Is this request only for public cloud marketplace listings or does it affect Private/Dedicated artifacts too?

maria: Public listings primarily. Private/Dedicated keep customer contracts, but public offer metadata must be canonical.

amy-legal: Marketplace requirements: some regions require localized EULAs (EU, JP, CA are common). Recommend minimum locales: en, fr, de, ja. Workflow = machine translation + native legal review for the legal text. Also we need a DPA reference link for EU data-processing in the listing metadata.

mike-partnerships: Azure requires a publisher support profile (phone + email + business hours). AWS and GCP prefer email + support URL; phone is optional. I'll confirm Azure's exact publisher schema fields by EOD.

devon: Operational proposal for support routing:
- trial SKUs: doc-first + support@redwood.ai + business-hours email triage
- enterprise SKUs: Redwood 24x7 pager + phone escalation listed
- partner-implemented projects: list SI/partner contact as implementation lead; Redwood remains primary for liability and SLA.

amy-legal: Confirmed. Contracts must show Redwood as the primary support/obligor for enterprise offers. Partners can be listed as implementation contacts only.

maria: I'll add these to the marketplace artifact template fields we need: support_email, support_url, support_phone (optional), sla_tier, locales.

maria: Draft metadata snippet to include in the offer artifact (will commit to repo):
```json
{
  "support_email": "support@redwood.ai",
  "support_url": "https://www.redwood.ai/support",
  "support_phone": "+1-888-555-0123",
  "sla_tier": "enterprise-24x7",
  "locales": ["en", "fr", "de", "ja"]
}
```

raj: Who covers translation costs and operational ownership?

amy-legal: Legal will arrange native legal reviews for EULA text. Partnerships will own the translation vendor budget and marketing copy localization.

mike-partnerships: I'll confirm the Azure phone requirement and exact publisher field names (EOD).

devon: I'll add the fields to the artifact template and include a small validation script that fails packaging if required locales or support fields are missing. Will open PR once mike confirms field names.

marketplace-bot: Listing draft uploaded to sandbox: sandbox-834. Status: metadata missing (locales/support) -> action required.

maria: Action items: 1) mike-partnerships: confirm Azure publisher schema + phone field (due EOD) 2) amy-legal: DPA checklist + translation/native-legal review workflow (due 2025-03-10) 3) devon: update artifact template + validation script (due next Monday) 4) maria: produce region->locale mapping and update marketplace checklist (doing today).

raj: +1 on timeline and routing. Thanks.

devon: PR incoming after mike confirms schema.

maria: I'll create a partnerships JIRA and link sandbox-834. :thumbsup:
